leads.posting: Zetwerk raises fresh issue size to Rs 2,830 Cr, OFS component up 49% in RHP. Manufacturing platform Zetwerk has filed its Red Herring Prospectus (RHP) for its initial public offering (IPO), comprising a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 2,830 crore. According to its RHP, the Bengaluru-based company has increased its fresh issue size to Rs 2,830 crore from Rs 2,600 crore proposed in its updated draft red herring prospectus (UDRHP). The offer for sale (OFS) has also increased by 49% to 14.45 crore shares from 9.68 crore shares proposed in the UDRHP filed in August. The OFS will include shares from promoters Amrit Pratik Acharya and Srinath Ramakkrushnan, who will each sell 1.42 crore shares. Promoter group entity Creovate Innovation will offload up to 2.30 crore shares. Together, they will offer around 5.14 crore shares. Among the existing investors, Lightspeed Venture Partners will offload the most, at 2.51 crore shares, followed by Peak XV Partners, which will sell 2.34 crore shares. Kae Capital Fund and Kalysta Capital Fund will collectively sell up to 1.67 crore shares. Accel India V will also participate in the OFS, offloading up to 1.2 crore shares. The offer will be open for subscription on October 15, 2026 to October 19, 2026 while anchor bid will start on October 14. Zetwerk plans to use Rs 1,300 crore from the fresh issue to repay or prepay borrowings at the company level. Another Rs 860 crore will be used to repay debt at nine subsidiaries. The remaining proceeds will be allocated towards acquisitions, strategic investments and general corporate purposes. Founded in 2017 by Acharya and Ramakkrushnan, Zetwerk operates a technology-led manufacturing platform that connects businesses with manufacturers and suppliers across sectors such as energy, electronics, aerospace, defence and industrial automation. leads.posting: D2C Brand Nat Habit Raises ₹142 Cr To Scale Offline Expansion. D2C personal care brand Nat Habit has raised ₹142 Cr (around $14.7 Mn) in an all-primary Series C funding round led by Trident Growth Partners to expand its distribution, product portfolio, and manufacturing capabilities. Existing investors Bertelsmann India Investments, Mirabilis Investment Trust, and Sharrp Ventures participated in the round, while Physis Capital and Hero Family Office joined the cap table. The startup plans to expand its offline presence from about 20,000 stores to 2 Lakh over the next three years. Alongside growing its general trade presence, Nat Habit will enter modern trade and expand its team to support the rollout. The expansion also involves reaching a broader consumer base. Having primarily targeted consumers with higher income and education levels, Nat Habit is now looking to reach what it calls the “Bharat consumer”, with changes to pack sizes and communication. Beyond offline retail, Nat Habit will use the fresh capital to strengthen its quick commerce presence and expand its product portfolio. It plans to enter categories such as sunscreens and serums, which it does not currently offer, with investments in R&D, formulation, and manufacturing facilities. “Our ambition now is to make our products accessible to many more households across India,” said cofounder Swagatika Das. Founded in 2019 by Das and Gaurav Agarwal, Nat Habit sells personal care products, including hair oils, masks, scrubs, and face creams. It says it combines traditional ayurvedic principles with modern science to develop plant-based formulations across haircare, skincare, body care, and baby care. The startup claims to have served more than 60 Lakh households across India and its annualised gross revenue reaching ₹330 Cr. leads.title: AI Internship
leads.posting: GoKwik is hiring for the role of AI Intern! Responsibilities of the Intern: Analyse brand P&Ls across revenue, COGS, marketing spend, discounts, logistics, RTO, payment costs and contribution margin. Diagnose growth opportunities across Source, Convert, Average Up, Loop Back and Evangelism. Build and execute 90-day growth plans with clear priorities and measurable outcomes. Monitor key D2C metrics including GMV, orders, CVR, AOV, CAC/CPO, ROAS, RTO, repeat rate and contribution margin. Audit Shopify storefronts and PDPs to identify conversion leaks and develop CRO hypotheses and experiments. Execute and improve growth playbooks across First-Time, Sale, BAU, Growth and Hyper-Growth situations. Identify business performance issues early and recommend corrective actions. Support weekly business reviews with founders through data-backed insights and recommendations. Identify repetitive workflows and use AI agents and automation to eliminate manual work. Capture learnings across brands and turn them into repeatable playbooks. Requirements: Highly curious about AI, agents, automation and how technology can change the way businesses operate. Comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets and basic business analysis. Excited by P&Ls, unit economics and understanding how a business makes money. Interested in D2C, eCommerce, growth and performance marketing. Able to move between data, strategy and execution without needing everything to be perfectly defined. A fast learner who can pick up new tools and concepts quickly. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with high attention to detail. Comfortable communicating insights and recommendations clearly. High-agency — you see a problem and figure out how to solve it rather than waiting for instructions. Someone who has experimented with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Replit, n8n, Make or similar tools is a strong plus.

leads.title: Junior Data Engineer
leads.posting: About the role Data is undeniably one of the world's most valuable resources. However, it's futile if it's not in the right place or the right setup. We strive to place data where it's needed most and can be used to its fullest potential. Become a valued member of our data integration team and start your journey building scalable data architectures and fast data pipelines for our multinational clients. Our use cases range from data warehouse and lakehouse architecture implementations over IoT and data streaming setups to sophisticated AI scenarios, in industries ranging from manufacturing, consumer products, and healthcare to banking and insurance, just to name a few.
